business_rules: Every visit draws a random ID; the monk's look and dharma name are derived from it. Leaving the temple ends that identity.
An ID belongs to whoever holds its token; the server refuses anyone else (covered by the server tests, not reachable from the UI).
Sitting time counts only while the monk sits and is kept when the monk stands or leaves.
There is no chat. The only interaction between monks is a bow. Chanting, wooden fish and bell sounds are synthesized on the device.
A standing monk can walk anywhere on the hall floor by tapping it; a seated monk stays on the cushion, and sitting down returns the monk to it.
A standing monk may sit on any free cushion; the app picks the nearest one and the wooden fish goes with the monk. A cushion someone else holds cannot be taken.
Walking never passes through pillars or other monks, and two standing monks are never drawn on the same spot.
Merit: a knock on the wooden fish +1, a prayer bead +1, a prostration +3, a trial held +10, a trial lost -20 (never below 0). Counted practices arrive in batches of at most 60.
Every change of merit is written down with its time, its reason, the amount and the total afterwards; the latest 100 are kept and shown newest first.

Trials of composure happen only to a seated monk. They come at random (can be switched off) or when the monk calls one with a button. Composure drains with real time; gathering the mind, knocking, beads and prostrations restore it. The monk cannot stand during a trial. Reaching zero ends the visit: merit drops and the monk leaves the hall.

A visitor may register an ID. A registered monk and their merit are kept; a return code, shown once, brings them back on another device and signs the old device out. Five wrong codes pause that ID for five minutes. Unregistered visitors are forgotten six hours after leaving.

Entering, registering, sitting, practices, trials, bows and leaving are written to the visit log with the monk's ID, a browser label and the country, region and city of the request. Polling and walking are not logged. IP addresses are not stored.

The visit dashboard at /admin belongs to one admin account. The first visitor to /admin sets it; afterwards only its password opens the visit log. Five wrong passwords pause it for five minutes. Without a valid session the log is never returned.
